title: DerivedPullbackCanonicalTensorShiftOne
statement: Let $f:Z\to Y$ be proper between Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism], with derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] in a shared localization universe and the recorded K-flat tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Equip $L=Lf^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback] with any supplied strong monoidal structure. Fix the canonical two-variable tensor shifts [def-sc-scheme-canonical-tensor-shift] on both schemes. There exists a coherent integer-shift structure $s_L$ on $L$ for which $L$ is triangulated and the following holds: for every $M\in D(\mathcal O_Y)$ and K-flat complex $P$ [def-pc-kflat-complex], put $K=Q(P)$ and let $\tau: (-\otimes M);L\to L;(-\otimes L(M))$ be the supplied inverse tensorator. With the composite shift structures, $s_{(-\otimes M);L}(1)_K;\tau_K[1]=\tau_{K[1]};s_{L;(-\otimes L(M))}(1)_K$. Only the pullback shift and this square are asserted, not tensor exactness or unitor compatibility.

source.place: K-flat total tensor translation calculation; parent representative-complex construction

proof.text: Use the explicit c_X(K): O_X[1] tensor K -> K[1]. The map a_K for pullback is the composite F(c_Y(K)^-1), delta_(O_Y[1],K), e tensor id, c_Z(F K). It is constructed from isomorphisms, with e left as a parameter.
Obtain s, e, triangulatedness, and s(1)_K = a_K from the exact translated-unit pullback lemma. This supplies the existential shift witness of the conclusion.

Naturality of c_X in a map b follows by the canonical CommShift2.commShift_flip_map square evaluated at the unit, followed by naturality of the left unitor. These are Mathlib NatTrans.shift_app_comm and MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor_naturality, applied explicitly in the private unit_shift_naturality proof.

Cancel c_Y(K tensor M) from the source associativity identity to obtain t_Y(K,M);c_Y(K tensor M)^-1 = (c_Y(K)^-1 tensor id_M);alpha_(O_Y[1],K,M). Apply F and expand a_(K tensor M). Move the shifted delta_(K,M) through c_Z by the preceding naturality square. Interchange e with delta using whisker_exchange, then use OplaxMonoidal.associativity to combine the two tensorators. Apply delta_natural_left to c_Y(K)^-1. Move e through the target associator using associator_naturality_left. Substitute the target c_Z associativity identity and cancel its associator with its inverse. The result is F(t_Y);a_(K tensor M);delta_(K,M)[1] = delta_(K[1],M);(a_K tensor id);t_Z(F K,F M). These identities are the explicit rewrite proof of tensor_unit_shift_square; no geometric tensorator-square lemma is used.

Expand the two composite CommShift isomorphisms at 1 by Functor.commShiftIso_comp_hom_app and substitute s(1)=a. Apply the previous square at K=Q(P). It holds for every K; the K-flat hypothesis need not be used in this final restriction.
